points.description: States that an orthotropic material has 9 independent elastic constants.
points.partial_credit: Half if the number is missing or wrong but the student says it has several/multiple independent elastic constants.

points.description: States that material properties at a point differ along three mutually orthogonal (perpendicular) axes (directions).
points.partial_credit: Half if properties are said to differ with direction but the three orthogonal axes are not mentioned.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) need both ideas: 9 elastic constants, and properties at a point differing along three orthogonal axes. Give part marks for a vague or partly wrong version, e.g. "properties differ with direction" with no mention of three orthogonal axes. A wrong statement on one point loses only that point; give 0 for unrelated answers such as "isotropic, same in all directions".
